title: Mohammad se Mohammad Tak
body:
khuda ka mukhtasar laskhar Muhammad say Muhammad tak
magar bhari hain lakho par Muhammad say Muhammad tak
maza ajayega madh e abutalib sunanay ka
milein gaye qabr kay andar muhamamd say Muhammad tak
nusayri kis ko kis ko apna rab manay ga tu akhir
nazar aty hain sub haider Muhammad say Muhammad tak
fulanay say fulanay tak sbhi rehbar tmhry hain
humry muntakib rehbar Muhammad say muhamamd tak
dar e khatoon e janat teri azmat kibriya janay
khary hain sub jhukaye sir muhamamd say Muhammad tak
bachaya deen ko hum nay bachaya hum ko zainab nay
khuda say kehty hain aksar muhamamd say Muhammad tak
nabowat hazrat e adam ko milna gair mumkin thi
na hotay nam jo azbar Muhammad say Muhammad tak
tilawat hogai quran ki mehsoos hota hai
faqt ek manqabat parh kar Muhammad say Muhammad tak
